system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: chc_search_machinery and chc_get_machinery_details.. my machinery_id is dummy_machinery_id_3117, my machinery_type is dummy_machinery_type_5671, my location is dummy_location_2537.

function.name: chc_get_machinery_details
function.description: Returns detailed info about specific machinery (type, capacity, hourly rate, condition). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT check availability. Fails if machinery_id invalid.

function.name: chc_search_machinery
function.description: Searches available farm machinery at CHC centres by type, location, and date. Returns machinery details and availability. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT book machinery. May return machinery that is reserved for other time slots. Fails if no machinery matches or location invalid.
